title: A Mile Wide, an Inch Deep: The State of Civic Learning in U.S. School Districts
summary_en: This brief is the first in a three-part series from the American School District Panel, a research partnership between RAND and CRPE that surveys hundreds of school district leaders.
title_cn: A Mile Wide, an Inch Deep: The State of Civic Learning in U.S. School Districts

title: Pooling Europe's compute: The promise of distributed training for European frontier AI
summary_en: Frontier AI training has needed compute at one site, hard in Europe given power, chip and political limits. RAND Europe finds distributed training eases the power and political constraints and pools Europe's scattered chips, but adds no new chips.
title_cn: Pooling Europe's compute: The promise of distributed training for European frontier AI
